thread:
maria_sales: Hey team — enterprise prospect wants a 60‑day on‑prem POC. Asking if we can do a temporary support tier bump (Gold -> Platinum) + waive platform fee for the POC window. Also need guidance on committed spend if they convert.

sam_se: Quick q — is this VPC-only or fully air‑gapped on‑prem? Security will ask about KMS/HSM and network isolation.

maria_sales: Fully on‑prem (air‑gapped). They specifically require KMS integration and a signed SOC2 addendum.

sam_se: Ok. For an air‑gapped POC we usually require an onprem platform fee to cover ops hours. If we waive fee, we should ask for a short committed minimum on conversion or larger credits.

alex_dealdesk: We can consider a platform fee waiver for up to 45 days, but 60 is longer. What committed ARR are they projecting? Need numbers for deal desk.

maria_sales: They estimated $250k ARR in year 1 if conversion happens. POC is to validate latency and KMS integration.

jordan_finance: If projection is $250k ARR, we can offer a 3‑month platform fee waiver + $25k onboarding credit, contingent on a 12‑month commit at standard Dedicated rates. Need legal to sign the SOC2 addendum and a CLM.

lee_dealdesk: @maria_sales send me their projected monthly usage (tokens/embeddings) and required support RTO. For Platinum support we need to price the uplift; can do a temporary upgrade at no charge if they commit to either a 12m term or a minimum 6m with a one‑time install fee.

maria_sales: Feeding back their POC resource ask: ```
Requirements:
- 4 x A100 equivalence (could be fractional Dedicated)
- 512GB RAM aggregate
- 1TB NVMe for model store
- KMS/HSM + audit logs
- Platinum support (24x7) for 60 days
```

sam_se: That config maps to our mid Dedicated SKU. For air‑gapped deploy ops estimate ~120 engineer hours for install + hardening. Ops‑hours cost is usually covered by platform fee unless we trade for contract length.

alex_dealdesk: Proposal draft: (1) 60‑day POC with waived platform fee, (2) $25k onboarding credit, (3) customer signs 12‑month Dedicated commit at X rate within 30 days post‑POC or credits convert to invoice. Approve in principle — need legal/finance signoffs.

jordan_finance: Finance tentatively ok on that structure. I'll mark subject to: legal sign SOC2 addendum, CISO confirms KMS approach, and revenue recognition terms approved.

lee_dealdesk: I'll approve a one‑time exception for platform fee waiver for the POC if sales puts the 12m commit in writing and we get an internal signoff ticket.

ops-bot: Ticket created: OPS-4521 — Onprem POC install window + security checklist. Assigned to @sam_se.

maria_sales: Great — I'll send the draft term sheet to legal and ask the customer to confirm monthly usage by EOD. Thanks all :thumbsup:

sam_se: FYI — if they want HSM, we need lead time for procurement. Bring that into the timeline.

lee_dealdesk: Also note — if they push for longer waiver we should swap to a larger onboarding credit instead of full waiver. Keeps alignment.

maria_sales: Noted. Will loop in legal + CISO.

(THREAD END)
